content.title: Public Bodies
content.intro: Government ministries and public institutions that Metiv works with, or through which some services are accessed.

partners.name: Ministry of Defense
partners.role: Partner in the Peace of Mind program; the Rehabilitation Department (Jerusalem District) refers patients to the Migdalor Clinic; funding for a NAMAL group for parents back from reserve duty
partners.forYou: People recognized by the Rehabilitation Department (Jerusalem District) come to the Migdalor Clinic on referral from the department. Veterans who were exposed to combat events can apply to Peace of Mind.

partners.name: Herzog Medical Center
partners.role: Metiv was founded as a branch of the hospital (Latner Institute) and operates on its campus; partner in the Migdalor Clinic
partners.forYou: Metiv's clinics operate on the medical center's campus in Givat Shaul, Jerusalem.

partners.name: National Insurance Institute (Bituach Leumi), health and welfare bodies
partners.role: Among the bodies that fund treatment at the Adult Clinic
partners.forYou: Some of the treatment at the Adult Clinic is funded by a public body. It is worth asking when you contact the clinic.

partners.name: Ministry of Education
partners.role: Partner in the National Resilience Program for schools
